description: This file defines the DataGroupDao class, which provides data access methods for DataGroup and DataGroupPermission entities within the OrangeHRM core authorization module. It includes methods for retrieving data groups, permissions by user roles, API permissions, filtered permissions, and listing all data groups.

classes.name: DataGroupDao
classes.description: Data access object for DataGroup and DataGroupPermission entities, providing methods to retrieve data groups, permissions, and API permissions based on various filters.

methods.name: getDataGroup
methods.description: Retrieves a DataGroup entity by its name.

methods.name: getDataGroupPermission
methods.description: Fetches permissions associated with specified data groups and user role, with optional self permission filter.

methods.name: getApiPermissions
methods.description: Retrieves API-related permissions for a given API class name and array of roles, which can be role names or UserRole objects.

methods.name: getDataGroupPermissions
methods.description: Filters and retrieves DataGroupPermissions based on provided filter parameters, including access restrictions and permissions scope.

methods.name: getDataGroups
methods.description: Lists all DataGroup entities ordered by description.
